input.summary: Add a performance-based exit to the obligation to order every credit report from TrueLink
input.comment: [Playbook] We cannot commit to source every credit report from TrueLink without an exit. We have narrowed this to borrowers underwritten through the Interface and added the right to use other providers where TrueLink cannot deliver or fails to meet the Section 3 service levels.

ops.oldText: Subject to the foregoing, Client shall order TrueLink a credit report on each borrower for which an underwriting approval is requested through a System using the Interface.
ops.newText: Subject to the foregoing, Client shall order from TrueLink a credit report on each borrower for which an underwriting approval is requested through a System using the Interface; provided that Client shall be free to obtain credit reports and similar services from any third party for any other purpose, and this obligation shall not apply if TrueLink fails to meet the service levels set forth in Section 3 or the requested data is not available through the Interface.

input.summary: Confirm 30 days' notice for Client convenience termination and add pro-rata refund of prepaid fees
input.comment: [Playbook] We accept Client's existing right to terminate on notice, but it should run on 30 days' notice and be free of penalty, with any prepaid fees refunded pro rata for the period after termination.

ops.oldText: until the last day of the month following the month in which Client provides TrueLink with a written notice of its election to terminate this Agreement.
ops.newText: until the effective date of termination specified in a written notice of Client's election to terminate this Agreement for convenience, which Client may give at any time on not less than thirty (30) days' prior written notice and without penalty or early-termination charge, and TrueLink shall refund any prepaid fees for the period after the effective date of termination.
